provenanceOfColours: MEASURED from this template rendered keyboard, not inferred from pitch. A pressed key deviates from its rest colour by 120-314 in RGB distance; an unpressed one by at most 23. Red tint versus cool-grey tint separates on redness (R-B)/R at roughly 0.5-1.0 versus about -0.08. The hand mapping is separately established from engraved staves below.
handMappingNote: Hand mapping comes from the visible engraved staves, never mean pitch. A held-span failure must not be hidden by this mapping.
pressDeviationNote: Euclidean RGB distance from the key own rest colour. Measured: 120-314 when pressed, at most 23 when not. 60 sits in the empty middle of that gap.
onsetLatencyNote: MEASURED against a transcription of this video own audio: 243 of 261 matched onsets sat at 90-100ms, median 95ms, and applying it leaves a median residual of 4ms (p90 8ms). The key tint therefore lights ~95ms BEFORE the note sounds in this render. LOCKED here; it must be tested unchanged on held-out footage before it is trusted on another video.
handMappingEvidence: Silksong end-card engraving by Samuel Dickenson: bars 1-4 note and staff comparison; further visible staves through bar 15 inspected. Red = right, grey = left. Whole-song sounding-span test: zero. Evidence: tools/video-lane/reconciliation-2026-09-09, score frame and release ledger. Reviewed 2026-09-09.
